name: pr-backtest
description: Recreate a GitHub PR at a chosen commit so PR-review bots can review it as it existed at that moment.

scripts.reinstall: npm run build && npm install -g . && echo "pr-backtest installed from $(git branch --show-current) @ $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.update: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only && npm install && npm run reinstall
